- Cytra Ledger is now Alloy Ledger, with the new Alloy logo
- /ll rollback player|near: preview (counts and particles), confirm, and /ll undo. Puts back broken blocks with their facing and contents, removes placed blocks, undoes container takes and puts
- Logs full block states, container contents and exact items from now on

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- The mod id is now alloymap: your saved maps, settings, marker pictures, key bindings and the server's shared map move over by themselves the first time it starts
- Commands are /alloymap and /alloymapc (the old /cytramap ones still work)
- Update the server and players together; don't keep the old Cytra Map jar next to it
